text:
Maya R.: Quick heads-up — NebulaCompute preview is greenlit. Nebula returned the NDA this morning (signed), partner-eng says nodes available next Tue. We need a concise plan for access, benchmark targets, and the feedback loop. Who can own what?

Luke H.: I can own infra access and validation. Need details on image / container + expected OS + ssh vs token access. Also: do we want a separate network for tests?

Olivia C.: I'll lead benchmarks. Proposed checklist: cold-start P50/P95, steady-state throughput, memory/KV cache footprint, quantized (int8/4-bit) perf, and multi-model concurrency. Will sketch a small harness.

Samir K.: NDA looks fine but flagged one clause: no persistent logs shipped off their infra. We need to ensure our bench collects only aggregated metrics. I'll post the exact wording we agreed to.

nebula-ci-bot: Access provisioned: nebula-preview-01 (10.0.2.5) — initial token created and DM'd to @Maya R.. Expiry in 14 days.

Maya R.: @Luke H. can you validate the token + node reachability by Monday? @Olivia C. please publish the harness repo and a short runbook (how to reproduce). Samir, we'll lock telemetry sampling to agg stats only (no raw request logs).

Luke H.: Confirmed. I'll validate SSH + docker image tomorrow. If Nebula prefers tokens, we'll wire the token into k8s secret: 

```
kubectl create secret generic nebula-token --from-literal=token=$NEBULA_TOKEN -n redwood-bench
kubectl apply -f bench-deployment.yaml
```

Olivia C.: Draft harness repo created: https://git.internal/redwood/nebula-bench (private). Initial test command: 

```
docker run --rm -e NEBULA_TOKEN=$TOKEN redwood/bench:latest \ 
  --model redwood-rlhf-1 --concurrency 8 --seq 512 --duration 300
```
I'll add a `targets.md` with target thresholds and test matrix tonight.

Samir K.: Uploaded the approved telemetry clause to the NDA thread. Short version: aggregated latency/histogram/CPU/GPU memory only. No raw prompts or customer data. Good to proceed once infra confirms the data flow.

Maya R.: Tentative timeline: Week 1 (onboard + smoke tests), Week 2 (baseline runs + quant), Week 3 (iterate with Nebula, collect feedback), Week 4 (joint sync + go/no-go on any public announcement). If benchmarks look great, partner-eng wants a marketplace tile draft.

Luke H.: Small request — can Nebula grant a secondary token for smoke runs so we don't blow the main token and can rotate? I'll ask partner-eng.

Maya R.: @Luke H. yes, asked Aria (Nebula PM) to create a rotateable token. She said yes, ETA Mon.

Olivia C.: I'll aim for a 2-hour smoke run script we can hand to partner-eng for early validation. Once we have baseline numbers I'll break out a short table for the internal deck.

Maya R.: Great. Action items: (1) Luke validate access + ask for secondary token (owner: Luke), (2) Olivia publish harness + targets.md (owner: Olivia), (3) Samir confirm telemetry restrictions (owner: Samir), (4) Maya coordinate partner comms and marketplace draft (owner: Maya).

Luke H.: On it. Will post validation results and the token rotation plan in this thread.

Olivia C.: Adding perf targets now. Will ping when `nebula-bench` is public to the team. :rocket: 

Samir K.: Noted, will confirm legal sign-off on telemetry by EOD Monday.

Maya R.: Thanks all. If anything blocks access or we need to escalate quotas, tag me and I'll loop in partner-eng.

nebula-ci-bot: Reminder — preview tokens expire in 14 days. Please rotate or request extension if needed.
